verdicts.why: Shoot the Moon: AVTF officers find Cherry at Metro-General watched over by Angie Kim and his NYPD friends; his police friends take him into hiding and Kim tells Josie he is safe.
The Hateful Darkness: Cherry, Kim and their NYPD allies escort Murdock and McDuffie out of the courthouse; the AVTF attacks in the parking lot and the police fight back.
Requiem: Cashman has Blake test BB with false intel. The Hateful Darkness: Blake texts Cashman where he will bring BB, lets her run, and Cashman kills him when he will not give her up.
The Hateful Darkness: Mahoney, who pulled strings to get Karen to the 15th Precinct, frees her from her cell, brings her to Daredevil behind the precinct and returns her.
The Hateful Darkness: Karen in police detention is visited by Murdock with the help of Chief of Detectives Brett Mahoney, who brings her out behind the precinct.
Shoot the Moon: Cashman handles Vanessa's security and says she needs no gun; she keeps it because she knows how dangerous Bullseye is.
The Southern Cross: Bullseye aims at Fisk in the courthouse lobby and Cashman shields Fisk from the bullet.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
value.text: Cherry and his police allies escort Kirsten out of the courthouse after Karen's first day of trial, and when the task force attacks, he gets her out of danger.
value.on_a_card_about_b: His boss at the firm, whom he gets clear of a task force attack.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Her investigator, who gets her clear of a task force attack.

verdicts.why: Events are right (Cherry and Kim evacuate McDuffie when the AVTF attacks), but the card lines are swapped: Cherry's card must describe Kirsten (his boss at the firm) and Kirsten's card must describe Cherry (her investigator).
The Northern Star: Cherry agrees to look into the ship's crew for Murdock; the AVTF tortures Cherry, Daredevil arrives to save him and is unmasked as Cherry has a heart attack.
The Hateful Darkness: Murdock joins McDuffie as co-counsel and cross-examines Connor Powell and Cole North to establish the illicit nature of Fisk's rule.
The Scales & The Sword: Powell reports to Kingpin that Daredevil freed the prisoners; Kingpin gives an order and Powell blows up the Northern Star with the workers aboard.
Shoot the Moon: Rivera and Blake examine the City Without Fear videos, Blake confirms only Fisk's circle had the footage, and Rivera advises him not to keep secrets from Fisk.

Dex kills the AVTF officers at Cherry's apartment to save Daredevil and the hospital officers as part of his one-man war on the AVTF; he and Cherry never exchange anything, and nothing shows he acts for Cherry.
The Grand Design opens with real 2014 flashbacks: Matt and Foggy get McCoy out, Foggy gives McCoy their firm savings, Matt is not upset and they go to Josie's still planning their firm.
The Grand Design flashbacks: Wesley tells Fisk McCoy refused the plea deal, suggests art through a friend's gallery, and is with Fisk at the gallery where Fisk sees Vanessa.
The Hateful Darkness: Glenn visits Fisk's office to ask how he feels now Vanessa is gone; he gives her Vanessa's second earring, knowing she stole one.
The Hateful Darkness: Murdock shows up as McDuffie's co-counsel at Karen's trial; the AVTF attacks them leaving court and Murdock is shot in the leg.
Requiem only replays the Daredevil S1 killing as archive footage in Karen's memory; Wesley has no new exchange with her, and the event already has its stage at Daredevil S1#11.

Shadows: a stranger (Triplett) plants a phone in Talbot's pocket at Potomac Plaza; Coulson warns him of the Absorbing Man, Talbot refuses the help, vows to send Coulson to Guantanamo and snaps the phone.
The Writing on the Wall: at a Philadelphia bus station Ward, wired with C-4, subtly shows Triplett his explosives and Triplett has to let him walk.
The Things We Bury: Triplett is shot; Zabo severs one of his veins, then shows Fitz and Coulson how to save him.
What They Become: May and Triplett fly the Bus, ejecting the pods and cloaking so the four Hydra Quinjets think it destroyed; they then go to San Juan to pursue Ward.
...Ye Who Enter Here: Skye collects Raina from Billy at the safe house, mistakes him for Sam, tackles Agent 33 and orders Billy to take Raina to the stairs.
Shadows: Coulson uses a scan of Talbot's voice to phone the warehouse guard, with Koenig advising him on Talbot's tone and phrasing.
Shadows: as May fights Creel, Skye subdues him with a Taser Projectile Launcher, saving Talbot; after the team kidnaps Talbot, Skye watches Coulson question him.
Aftershocks: Simmons shows Skye Raina's altered DNA and calls those with powers a plague; Fitz swaps Skye's samples and they keep her change from Simmons.
S.O.S. Part One (S2#21): after the missile strike on Afterlife, May refuses to leave without finding Gonzales; Skye fights her and knocks her out with her powers.
The Dirty Half Dozen: Skye, Simmons and Ward find Deathlok held by Hydra (List removing his eye); he tells them Lincoln was taken elsewhere and Skye rescues him.
Love in the Time of Hydra: on Garner's recommendation Coulson pulls Skye from active duty and leaves her at a safe house with gloves to learn control of her powers.
Shadows 1945 opening: Carter, Dugan and Morita capture the last known Hydra base, Dugan handcuffs Reinhardt, and they lock away the artifacts as Dugan asks Carter what they are.
One Door Closes: Weaver speaks to Fitz and Simmons, surprised to see her alive, explains how she survived Hydra and says Coulson has no right to call his group S.H.I.E.L.D.
Heavy Is the Head: Coulson offers Talbot Creel for breathing room; Talbot tries to capture him until the Bus decloaks with its guns aimed.
Making Friends and Influencing People: Fitz enters Ward's cell, drains its oxygen and lets slip Gill is the target; Ward warns Gill was already a Hydra asset.
...Ye Who Enter Here: May leads the agents surrounding Ward at gunpoint as he boards the Bus; Ward promises the Quinjets will not fire if Raina and Skye come, and May angrily agrees.
The Frenemy of My Enemy: Coulson, Hunter, Fitz and Peterson capture Ward and Palamas and deal: Ward gets them inside Hydra in exchange for a clean slate by memory wipe.
